<script type="text/javascript">
    (function (currentScript) {
        window.BottleNexus ? BottleNexusInit() : loadScript();
        function loadScript() {
            var script = document.createElement('script');
            script.async = true;
            script.src = 'https://buybutton.bottlenexus.com/buybutton.min.js?v=1704292502918';
            (document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0] || document.getElementsByTagName('body')[0]).appendChild(script);
            script.onload = BottleNexusInit;
        }
        function BottleNexusInit() {
            BottleNexus.init().createComponent({
                currentScript: currentScript,
                token: '901bf122-a9ba-11ee-a7bd-0242ac110002',
                id: 3012,
                options: {
				    "iframe": true,
				    "layout": "basic",
				    "behavior": "sidebar",
				    "buttonRadius": "0",
				    "buttonFontSize": 16,
				    "buttonWidth": 250,
				    "buttonAlignment": "center",
				    "buttonText": "ADD TO CART",
				    "buttonTextColor": "#FFFFFFFF",
				    "buttonBackground": "#000000ff",
				    "cartButtonRadius": 0,
				    "cartCheckoutBackgroundColor": "#000000ff",
				    "cartCheckoutBackgroundDisabledColor": "#B2B2B2FF",
				    "cartCheckoutTextColor": "#FFFFFFFF",
				    "cartHeadingText": "Cart",
				    "cartCheckoutText": "CHECKOUT",
				    "cartEmptyText": "No products added",
				    "cartAdditionalInformationText": "We are currently not shipping to MI / UT / MA / SD / AK / HI. All alcohol orders are processed and fulfilled by licensed third-party retailers on the Bottle Nexus network. The checkout functionality is provided solely for the convenience of our consumers.",
				    "cartBackgroundColor": "#FEFEFEFF",
				    "cartTextColor": "#000000FF",
				    "utm": {
				        "source": "BuyButton"
				    },
				    "styles": {
				        "[data-component='button']": {
				            "background-color": "transparent",
				            "color": "black",
				            "border": "black solid 1px",
				            "font-weight": "bold",
				            "margin-bottom": "5px"
				        },
				        "[data-component='button']:hover": {
				            "background-color": "transparent",
				            "color": "black",
				            "border": "black solid 3px",
				            "font-weight": "bold",
				            "margin-bottom": "5px"
				        }
				    }
				}
            });
        }       
    })(document.currentScript);
</script>
